content: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 440b-41b carries Tarjuma-yi Aḥādīs-i Mamzūj bā Sukhanān-i ʿAlī u Aʾimma (variants Tarjuma-yi Aḥādīs az Amīr al-Muʾminīn, Sharḥ al-Nahj), undated and incomplete; it is the only known copy. Melvin-Koushki reports that the title has seemingly been defaced and the text is abruptly truncated.
